purchase_price.evidence: Trivo lists Unit 60 as 3 dormitorios, 107m², Precio $96,900. Immediate delivery in Nahla Barbasquillo.

monthly_rent.evidence: FazWaz Manta apartment averages show 3BR ~$825/mo. Barbasquillo comps: unfurnished 65m² 3BR $490 (U4098569); large 180m² 3BR $1,500 (U4136054). Subject 107m² new amenity building — between those poles. Conservative vs scout $825: used $750 (range $650-900) reflecting size/amenity mid-tier without verified lease comps in Nahla itself.

hoa_monthly.evidence: No published HOA for Nahla. Larger 3BR units typically pay higher alicuota by m² share. Amenity-rich building suggests $100-200/mo possible; Barbasquillo comps with fewer amenities ~$78/mo. Unverified — material to cap rate.

special_assessments.evidence: New delivery building; no assessment history found. Cannot confirm zero without HOA docs.

property_taxes_annual.evidence: Ecuador impuesto predial is 0.025%-0.5% of cadastral value (typically well below market). Comparable Manta condos often pay $100-400/yr. For ~$96,900 market price, estimated $77-290/yr; used $120. Exact bill depends on Manta municipal rate and cadastral assessment.

insurance_annual.evidence: Building structure insurance is typically included in Ecuador alicuota. Owner contents/liability: ~$140-210/yr base; Manta coastal earthquake risk adds 15-20%. For ~$96,900 condo, estimated $200-400/yr supplemental owner policy; used $300.

management_annual.evidence: Ecuador long-term property management typically 8-15% of rent. At $750/mo, 10% = $900/yr. Self-management possible with local presence (would be $0).

utilities_annual.evidence: For long-term Ecuador rentals, electricity/water/internet are typically tenant-paid. For STR, utilities are usually recovered in nightly rates or included in management fee. Owner direct cost assumed $0 under standard lease; if owner-paid budget $600-1,500/yr.

other_expenses_annual.evidence: Misc maintenance/reserves for 107m² unit. Estimated $300/yr pending HOA inclusions.

rental_restrictions.evidence: Same Nahla marketing: designed for living and rental/Airbnb investment. No rental ban identified.

str_restrictions.evidence: Airbnb-friendly marketing; Manta STR regulation Low per AirROI. Confirm reglamento interno at purchase.

notes: Largest Nahla unit in SCREENED set. Gross yield screen used $825; researched rent trimmed to $750 pending unit-specific comps. HOA still the dominant unknown. Prefer LTR over average STR given AirROI $4.1k/yr market average.
